content.value_statement: Meeting records and live interactions are spread across several Lark objects and identifiers. This skill routes lark-cli workflows while preserving identity and permissions.
actual_capabilities: Search historical meetings and discover active meetings using user or application identity.
Retrieve meeting details, participant snapshots, recordings, Notes, Minutes, and related document identifiers.
Read summaries, action items, chapters, keywords, transcripts, and shared meeting documents.
Create Minutes from uploaded media and edit titles, summaries, action items, keywords, or speakers.
Join or leave meetings with an application bot and send visible text or reactions.
Apply for Minutes access and manage collaborators when the user explicitly requests permission changes.
limitations: Requires an installed and authenticated lark-cli with suitable Lark scopes and tenant access.
Results remain limited by the selected identity, resource permissions, application installation, and data-access rules.
Meeting scheduling, availability, and room management require the separate lark-calendar skill.
Some transcript operations require user identity, and media downloads create local files.

use_cases.title: Review a completed meeting
use_cases.description: Find the correct meeting, retrieve its transcript, and produce a focused summary with action items.

use_cases.title: Maintain Minutes content
use_cases.description: Create Minutes from media, correct speakers, update summaries, and verify each requested change.

use_cases.title: Support a live meeting
use_cases.description: Use an authorized application bot to join, read current events, send requested messages, and leave.

prompt_templates.title: Find a meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Find my Lark meeting titled [title] from [date]. Show matching meetings with times and organizers before selecting one.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a transcript
prompt_templates.prompt: Open the transcript for meeting [meeting ID]. Summarize decisions, unresolved questions, owners, and due dates from the original discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Create and verify Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Lark Minutes from [local media path]. Return the link, wait until ready, then extract the transcript and verify completion.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate a live meeting bot
prompt_templates.prompt: Join meeting [meeting number] with the application bot. Read current events, send [message] after confirming content, then leave only when requested.

output_examples.input: Find yesterday's product review and list its decisions.
output_examples.output: Found one matching meeting: Product Review, 14:00-14:45. Decisions: keep the September launch date and run a security review before release.

output_examples.input: Create Minutes from the customer interview recording.
output_examples.output: The upload and Minutes creation request completed. The Minutes link is available, but transcript generation is still processing.

output_examples.input: Send a thumbs-up reaction in the active design meeting.
output_examples.output: The reaction was sent to the confirmed active design meeting using the same identity that discovered it.

best_practices: Confirm the unique meeting, Minutes, or Note identifier before reading or changing content.
Preserve the identity that produced each identifier and explain any required identity change.
Require explicit user intent for visible messages, bot participation, edits, uploads, downloads, and permission changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat meeting numbers, meeting IDs, Note IDs, document tokens, and Minutes tokens as interchangeable.
Do not switch identities to bypass permissions or repeat failed writes automatically.
Do not claim asynchronous Minutes artifacts are ready until a follow-up check confirms completion.

faq.question: What must be installed?
faq.answer: Install lark-cli and authenticate an identity with the scopes required for the requested meeting operation.

faq.question: Can it schedule meetings?
faq.answer: No. Use lark-calendar for scheduling, availability, room management, and future calendar events.

faq.question: Can it read every meeting?
faq.answer: No. Access depends on the selected identity, tenant installation, application data scope, and each resource permission.

faq.question: Can it modify Minutes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update supported fields after the user identifies the target and explicitly requests the change.

faq.question: Can an application bot join automatically?
faq.answer: No. A meeting number alone is insufficient. The user must explicitly authorize the bot to join.

faq.question: Where are downloaded files stored?
faq.answer: Downloads use documented relative directories unless the user supplies another safe relative path.
